description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the JobTitleService in the OrangeHRM project. It contains multiple test cases verifying functionalities such as fetching, deleting, and retrieving job titles, utilizing mocks and test data configurations.

classes.name: JobTitleServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the JobTitleService functions, such as retrieving, deleting, and processing job titles in OrangeHRM's admin module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of JobTitleService, and loads test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleList
methods.description: Verifies that JobTitleService correctly retrieves a list of JobTitle objects.

methods.name: testDeleteJobTitle
methods.description: Checks that JobTitleService correctly deletes job titles by IDs and returns expected count.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single JobTitle object by its ID.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleArray
methods.description: Verifies the conversion of JobTitle objects into an array format with specific keys.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleArrayForEmployee
methods.description: Checks that job titles associated with an employee are returned correctly in array format.
